feature_contract.preprocessing: median imputation and linear scaling fitted inside folds

incumbent_reference.note: The incumbent target differs; RMSE non-inferiority is therefore evaluated against the positive-ElasticNet architecture on the new target.

promotion_gate.rule: Retain the incumbent defensive head unless every predeclared predictive, noncollapse, spurious-feature, and leave-one-team-out check passes.

validation.leave_one_team_out: held-out team rows; all matches involving that team removed from training
